title: Blender Tutorial - 3D Modeling and Sculpting a Game Ready Viking Axe
description:
Let's model the Leviathan axe from God of War in Blender! Following these steps, everyone can learn this! New to Blender? Check out my beginner course https://www.patreon.com/posts/beginner-course-77595105

What you will learn: 
- the phases of 3D modeling
- everything you need to model in 3D
- the most important sculpting brushes
- different useful blender functions and modifiers

Uncut full-process video in any speed & alpha textures used on https://www.patreon.com/in2vert.
